text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Aston 
Machan—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech, —slam!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yappee! What a coincidence bumping into 
you two♪ How've you been?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Maruzen-san. Hello, it's 
Machan, just returned from an outing. I'm 
doing well."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry to call out to you so 
suddenly. I just saw a familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. Chan and the others are just 
going home now, so... not at all—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Are you curious about Tac-chan, by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, that is true. A bright red 
supercar sounds wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan's father also sells foreign cars, so 
Chan couldn't help but be curious.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I have fond memories of cars. Memories of 
my father driving the family to the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The things we talked about in the car, the 
smiling faces of my family, I remember all 
of it—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it is decided. Once Machan comes 
of age, she will get her driver's license.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll get my license and drive a super 
impactful supercar! Extra helpings of 
memories!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wonderful♪ In that case, Big Sis will 
help you get your license!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Helping out...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, feel the sensation of driving with 
your whole body! Now, hop on Tacchan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after watching them get into the 
two-seater and drive off, a short while 
later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vroooom—SCREECH!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer. I was actually planning 
to run a bit more, but—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...No... I can't... take any more...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Please don't ask... Whenever I remember, 
Machan... Machan just—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That roaring sound of the engine... The 
dazzling cornering and the screech of 
tires...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Did you know, Trainer? Cars actually shake 
vertically too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is Machan spinning? Or is it the 
world...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —*gasp*

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, that won't do. Machan has 
decided to forget everything."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll forget everything. Yes, absolutely 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Umm, did I get a wiiittle too carried away 
and push the pace too much...?
choice_data_list: That was some grueling training, huh.

That was some grueling training, wasn't 
it?

Hearing you talk about it got me a little 
curious—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Umm, did I get a wiiittle too carried away 
and push the pace too much...?
choice_data_list: That was some grueling training, huh.

That was some grueling training, wasn't 
it?

Hearing you talk about it got me a little 
curious—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, especially when we entered the road 
along the coast—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no. Forget it. Mar-chan never rode 
in a car.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I think I'll hold off on getting my 
driver's license for a while," aston 
machan said, her face pale.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't. Please reconsider. That is 
not something a human can endure...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If you really insist, Machan can get a 
driver's license and give you a ride."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan stopped me with a deadly 
serious look on her face. She must have 
had quite an experience...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heeding the advice, I walked a dizzy Aston 
Machan back to the dorms.
